header.running_head: Imaan (Belief) In the Being of Allaah and His Attributes

blocks.text: مَا شَاءَ اللّٰهُ وَحْدَهٗ لَا شَرِيْكَ لَهٗ' ('What the One Allaah Who has no partner wills')."[^1]

Hadhrat Hudhayfah (RA) narrates that one of the Muslims saw in a dream that he met a man from the Ahlul Kitaab who said to him, "You people are excellent people had it not been for your committing Shirk by saying "مَا شَاءَ اللّٰهُ وَشَاءَ مُحَمَّدٌ' ('What Allaah and Muhammad ﷺ wills')." When he reported the dream to Rasulullaah ﷺ, Rasulullaah ﷺ said, "I had always disliked you saying this. You should rather say, 'What Allaah wills'. Thereafter, you may add what someone else wills."[^2]

Hadhrat Abdullaah bin Abbaas (RA) narrates that when a man came to discuss something with Rasulullaah ﷺ, the man said, "What Allaah wills and what you will." Rasulullaah ﷺ rebuked him saying, "Are you equating me with Allaah!? It is only what the One Allaah wills (that will happen)."[^3]
A Jew Questions Rasulullaah ﷺ about Volition

Imaam Awzaa'ee reports that a Jew once approached Rasulullaah ﷺ asking about volition. Rasulullaah ﷺ replied, "Everything occurs by the will of Allaah." "What if I decide to stand up?" the man asked. "Then it is by Allaah's will that you will stand," Rasulullaah ﷺ replied. The man asked further, "And if I decide to sit?" "Then it is by Allaah's will that you will sit," Rasulullaah ﷺ replied. Again the Jew asked, "And what if I decide to cut down this date palm?" Again Rasulullaah ﷺ replied, "Then it is by Allaah's will that you will cut it." "And if I then decide to leave it alone?" he asked. "Then," Rasulullaah ﷺ replied, "it is by Allaah's will that you will leave it."
Hadhrat Jibra'eel (AS) then came and said to Rasulullaah ﷺ, "You have been inspired to present the correct facts just as Ibraheem (AS) was inspired." It is in the same meaning that Allaah says in the Qur'aan:

blocks.arabic_text: مَا قَطَعْتُمْ مِّنْ لِّيْنَةٍ أَوْ تَرَكْتُمُوْهَا قَآئِمَةً عَلٰى أُصُوْلِهَا فَبِإِذْنِ اللّٰهِ وَلِيُخْزِيَ الْفٰسِقِيْنَ
blocks.text: Every date palm that you (Muslims) cut (and burnt) or left standing on its roots[^4] was by Allaah's permission and to humiliate the sinners (it was done by Allaah's command and not merely to destroy property). {Surah Hashar, verse 5}[^5]
